# What the framework gives us

Read out of `frappe` at `11fb93570c`. Regenerate with `python scripts/reference.py`.

Reach for something here before writing your own. If nothing fits, say so in a line.

## Mounting a page

* `frappe.ui.mount_island(el, name, props)` — mount a Vue island in a desk page
* `frappe.utils.island.get_island_assets` — resolve an island's module and styles
* `Workspace` — a page built from links, shortcuts, charts and cards
* `frappe/desk/page/* (5 pages)` — the classic desk page
